detail.longDescription: I am suddenly unable to access my AWS EC2 instance. The AWS Console shows that all status checks are passing (3/3 passed), indicating the hardware and hypervisor are healthy. However, I cannot establish any external connection. OS type is Ubuntu :) It's is production server / not Free tier. using key pairs to access terminal. What I have tried and verified: -Instance Lifecycle: I have completely stopped and relaunched the EC2 instance, but the issue persists. Storage Upgrade: I suspected the disk might be full, so I increased the EBS volume storage from 30 GB to 60 GB and modified the volume in AWS. Security Groups: I have temporarily opened all inbound and outbound ports to 0.0.0.0/0 , but connections still time out. Connection Methods: I have tried connecting via standard SSH (FIileZilla) and AWS EC2 Instance Connect. Both completely time out. show Failed Status
